name: durable_frame_run

test_list.description: run_frame executes an actual read through KernelToolRunner, replays the exact provider tool-call id and output in the second request, and persists two monotonic FrameStepRecorded events with CAS transcripts.

After a successful tool round, a synthetic provider failure on the second attempt persists a distinct failed event and transcript containing its captured request; no proof-of-done or terminal completion is asserted.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: Active capability-bound frame backed by an actual temporary Kernel session.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Deterministic fixture stream for one actual read_file tool call and then either ordinary text or a provider failure.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Production authorizer and executor wired to the actual kernel filesystem and CAS.

inputs.name: journal
inputs.description: Production frame journal wired to the same session, CAS and durable event bus.

output_description: A bounded multi-turn run whose step records, actual tool result, replayed provider-call history, CAS transcript ids, and event sequence are inspectable. Tokenizer upper bounds and verifier fingerprints are explicitly synthetic fixture values; no proof-of-done is established.
